title: Mike LaFleur: I wanted Nathaniel Hackett and no one else as Cardinals' OC

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike LaFleur: I wanted Nathaniel Hackett and no one else as Cardinals' OC
sources.description: The Cardinals formally introduced Nathaniel Hackett as their new offensive coordinator today, and head coach Mike LaFleur said Hackett was always the man he wanted for the job.
